audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 correctly frames a range-safe artillery mage that out-pokes Leona pre-6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet itself flags this: 'level chart contradicts data: Leona wins 52.96% but the chart gives Xerath 7/7 stages vs 0'. phases[0-6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0-6] all read Xerath and every content why already explains it correctly.
audit.why: Xerath's Arcanopulse (Q, 750 range) and Eye of Destruction (W) out-range Leona's entire kit pre-6, Shocking Orb (E) is a point-and-click stun that cancels her dash on cooldown, and Rite of the Arcane (R, 5000 range) bombards from off-screen — content whys already document this per-stage; only the full-layer chart rows were left on the stale Skill template.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0-6].side to Xerath and rewrite each .why from the kit; win[N] needs no edit since it already reads Xerath.

audit.why: Shocking Orb's point-and-click stun cancelling Zenith Blade's dash and the R channel being interruptible are already correctly documented in the content layer.

edits.before: Auto-trade behind passive marks — your carry's follow-up hits harder than the lane reads.
edits.after: Arcanopulse (Q) out-ranges your entire kit at 750 — he pokes you before you can walk into engage range at level 1.

edits.before: E-Q online — the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade.
edits.after: Q-plus-W poke-and-slow at level 2 shuts down your first all-in window before Zenith Blade closes the gap.

edits.before: Full chain: E-Q-W locks a carry for the full duo rotation; pick the window.
edits.after: Shocking Orb (E) unlocks at 3 — a point-and-click stun that cancels your dash on cooldown, not on a read.

edits.before: Zone with chain threat — their carry farms where your E says.
edits.after: His mana sustain lets him poke on cooldown at 4-5, grinding you down faster than you can trade back.

edits.before: Solar Flare online — dives start from two screens and the sun votes center-stun.
edits.after: Shocking Orb plus Rite of the Arcane (5000 range) punish your engage harder than Solar Flare punishes his positioning — land E on you and you eat the full bombardment.

edits.before: First item: the chain hardens and every landed E is a kill.
edits.after: His first poke item turns Arcanopulse into a caster-minion-sized chunk, forcing you to hide in fog rather than protect your carry.

edits.before: Late Leona starts everything: flare the entry, chain the carry, eclipse the answer.
edits.after: He scales into a range-safe artillery threat; you're reactive engage until items let you punish his step-up with R.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Arcanopulse (Q, 750 range) beats your engage range — hold max distance and let the poke land on nothing.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: His E (Shocking Orb) stuns on cast, not on cooldown-need — trading autos into it just hands him a free cancel.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Xerath's E (Shocking Orb) is up every 13s at rank 1, 11s at rank 5 — his only CC, and it cancels your dash on cast. - His R resets in 130s at rank 1, 100s at rank 3 — that's your longest safe engage window. - Spend your own R on swing moments only.

notes: Packet itself flags the chart contradiction (Leona wins 52.96% overall but chart read Xerath 7/7 — note the packet's own flag conflates overall winrate with per-stage lane tempo, which is fine; content win[N] already correctly reads Xerath all 7 rows and matches). Fixed phases[].side/why to match, plus both COPY_PASTE_BLEED and the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT lint findings.
